title: How I scaled my 1,400 browser game platform using Cloudflare, Supabase, and Gemini API to automate content and hit 60 FPS
author: browser_gamer
selftext:
​

Hey guys! I’ve been building Game Universe, a web platform aiming to host a curated collection of 1,400+ instant-play browser games with smooth 60 FPS performance and zero downloads required.

I recently set up a super fun game called "Drifting Car Master." The mechanic is wild—there is no speed or brake button at all. The car continuously auto-accelerates and stays permanently in a drift state. You have to constantly steer left and right to chain continuous drifts; if you stop adjusting for even a second, the car veers off-track and smashes into obstacles.

Managing a library of 1,400 games brought a huge technical bottleneck: writing accurate game guides and descriptions manually for every single game was impossible. To solve this without adding gameplay AI, I built an automated workflow using the Gemini API paired with the Exa internet search API. It searches real-time web data for each game and generates accurate, human-like guides (around 90%+ accurate). I even generated 50 custom user avatar profiles for the site in under 30 minutes using AI automation.

For performance, hosting everything via Cloudflare Pages combined with Supabase for data management kept asset delivery lightweight and frame rates locked at 60 FPS.

If you want to try out this crazy auto-accelerating drift mechanic directly in your browser, you can check it out here: https://gkgameuniverse.com/game/drifting-car-master
